situation: You missed a class because you were ill, and you want to catch up.
points: Explain why you missed the class
Ask how to get the notes or materials
Ask whether the missed quiz can be made up
model:
Dear Professor Lee,

I am sorry that I missed Tuesday's class. I had a fever and my doctor advised me to stay home.

Could you tell me the best way to get the notes and handouts from that session? I would also like to ask whether it is possible to make up the quiz that was given that day.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Sam Rahman

situation: The heating in your apartment has stopped working.
points: Describe the problem
Explain how it is affecting you
Ask when it can be repaired
model:
Dear Mr. Patel,

I am writing to let you know that the heating in my apartment, number 4B, stopped working on Sunday evening. The radiators are completely cold.

The nights have been very cold, and it has been difficult to sleep and study at home.

Could you please let me know when someone can come to repair it? I am at home most afternoons after three.

Thank you,
Maria Lopez

to: The manager of a student club
situation: You want to join the club but cannot attend the regular meeting time.
points: Say why you are interested in the club
Explain your schedule problem
Ask whether there are other ways to take part
model:
Hello,

I am a first-year student and I am very interested in joining the film club. I have always enjoyed discussing movies with friends.

Unfortunately, I have a lab class on Wednesday evenings, when the club usually meets.

Are there other ways I could take part, such as weekend screenings or an online group?

Best wishes,
Amir Hassan

situation: You are working on a group project, and one member has not done their part.
points: Remind them of the deadline
Explain what is still missing
Suggest a way to finish on time
model:
Hi Jordan,

I hope you are well. Just a reminder that our group presentation is due this Friday.

We still need your section on the survey results, including the two charts we discussed.

Could we meet tomorrow after class to finish it together? That way we will have time to practice on Thursday.

Thanks,
Li Na

situation: You returned a book, but the system still shows it as overdue.
points: Explain when and how you returned the book
Describe the problem
Ask them to correct your account
model:
Dear Library Staff,

I returned the book Principles of Ecology on March 3, using the drop box at the main entrance.

However, my online account still lists the book as overdue, and a late fee has been added.

Could you please check your records and remove the fee? My student number is 20231187.

Thank you for your help,
David Kim

to: Your manager at a part-time job
situation: You need to change one of your shifts next week.
points: Say which shift you need to change
Explain the reason
Suggest a solution
model:
Dear Ms. Green,

I am scheduled to work on Thursday evening next week, but I have just learned that my final exam is on Friday morning.

I would like to use Thursday evening to prepare.

I could work on Saturday instead, or my coworker Ben has said he is willing to swap shifts with me. Would either option be possible?

Thank you,
Priya Shah

to: A professor you have not met
situation: You want to ask about doing research in their lab.
points: Introduce yourself
Explain your interest in their research
Ask whether there are opportunities to join
model:
Dear Dr. Mensah,

My name is Lucas Ferreira, and I am a second-year biology student.

I recently read your article on soil bacteria and drought, and I found it fascinating, especially the field experiments.

I would like to ask whether there might be an opportunity for an undergraduate to help in your lab next semester. I would be happy to meet at a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
Lucas Ferreira

situation: You stayed at a hotel and left something in your room.
points: Say when you stayed and in which room
Describe the item
Ask how you can get it back
model:
Dear Front Desk,

I stayed at your hotel from June 10 to June 12 in Room 318.

I believe I left my phone charger, a white cable with a small black plug, plugged in beside the bed.

Could you please let me know if it was found, and whether it could be posted to me? I would be happy to pay the cost.

Thank you,
Hana Sato
